newsitem.title: USA: Carpenter to buy ICI Australia business.
newsitem.headline: Carpenter to buy ICI Australia business.

text.p: Carpenter Technology Corp said Tuesday that it has agreed to buy the structural ceramic component and powder business of ICI Australia Ltd for $16.5 million, pending the successful completion of a definitive agreement and due diligence.
Closing is tentatively set for August.
ICI Advanced Ceramics employs about 200 people and is expected to be profitable on sales of about $21 million in its fiscal year ending Sept 30, said Carpenter.

Carpenter, historically a specialty metals manufacturer, said it began investigating advanced ceramics technologies earlier this decade as a way to meet emerging specialty materials needs of some of its 14,000 customers.

The ICA businesses provide alumina- and zirconia-based structural ceramic parts for a variety of applications, such as medical instruments, valves and fittings for the pulp and paper and chemical industries, and tooling. Carpenter provides metals for similar applications.
